description:
Alterations include: 
Removal of existing internal fittings including failed shelving, two sinks, removal of stud wall used to create a storage cupboard.
Addition of stainless steel shelving using around 20 new and existing screw holes in the mortar. All removable. Stainless steel wall protection, removable.
Addition of freestanding stainless steel catering units for preparation of food and drink, plus fridges and freezer.
Installation of small shelving unit to house cash register.  Removable.
Permission to retain cafe title, printed white on black on polyurethane board approx 10cm x 40cm, screwed into wooded fascia board above entrance door of cafe
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and materials, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>
